tomato.name: Tomato
tomato.description: Heat-loving summer fruiting vegetable. Sow under cover, transplant after the last frosts.

carrot.name: Carrot
carrot.description: Root to sow directly in light, stone-free soil.

lettuce.name: Lettuce
lettuce.description: Fast-growing salad, sow in succession to harvest all season long.

radish.name: Radish
radish.description: Ready in about 4 weeks, ideal for beginners.

green_bean.name: Green bean
green_bean.description: Frost-sensitive legume to sow directly once the soil is warm. Enriches the soil with nitrogen.

pea.name: Pea
pea.description: Cool-season legume to sow early in spring. Enriches the soil with nitrogen.

zucchini.name: Zucchini
zucchini.description: Vigorous and very productive plant, needs plenty of water and organic matter.

cucumber.name: Cucumber
cucumber.description: Loves warmth and regular watering, can be trellised.

potato.name: Potato
potato.description: Tuber planted in spring, to be earthed up as it grows.

onion.name: Onion
onion.description: Bulb grown from seed or sets, dislikes excess water.

garlic.name: Garlic
garlic.description: Cloves planted in autumn or late winter in well-drained soil.

leek.name: Leek
leek.description: Very hardy winter vegetable, transplanted in summer.

spinach.name: Spinach
spinach.description: Cool-season leafy vegetable that bolts quickly in hot weather.

cabbage.name: Cabbage
cabbage.description: Nutrient-hungry vegetable that likes heavy, moist soils.

pepper.name: Bell pepper
pepper.description: Very frost-sensitive, sow in a warm place in late winter.

eggplant.name: Eggplant
eggplant.description: Needs plenty of heat and sun to produce well.

squash.name: Squash
squash.description: Trailing plant that takes a lot of space, harvest before the frosts.

corn.name: Sweet corn
corn.description: Sow in blocks rather than rows for good pollination.

celery.name: Celery
celery.description: Likes rich, moist soils, regular watering is essential.

fennel.name: Fennel
fennel.description: Bulb sown in summer, slows down the growth of many neighbouring plants.

turnip.name: Turnip
turnip.description: Fast root, mostly grown in late summer for autumn.

strawberry.name: Strawberry
strawberry.description: Perennial planted in late summer or spring, spreads by runners.

basil.name: Basil
basil.description: Frost-sensitive herb, sow in warmth and pinch regularly.

chives.name: Chives
chives.description: Easy perennial that grows back after each cut.

thyme.name: Thyme
thyme.description: Mediterranean perennial herb that likes dry, poor soils.

dill.name: Dill
dill.description: Annual herb that attracts beneficial insects.

marigold.name: French marigold
marigold.description: Flower that repels nematodes and some insects, a classic companion for tomatoes.

nasturtium.name: Nasturtium
nasturtium.description: Aphid trap plant, flowers and leaves are edible.

plant_associations.basil__tomato: Basil repels some pests and is said to improve the flavour of tomatoes.
plant_associations.marigold__tomato: French marigold repels nematodes and whiteflies.
plant_associations.carrot__tomato: Carrots loosen the soil around tomatoes.
plant_associations.nasturtium__tomato: Nasturtium draws aphids away from tomatoes.
plant_associations.carrot__onion: Onion repels the carrot fly, carrot repels the onion fly.
plant_associations.carrot__leek: Leek repels the carrot fly, and vice versa.
plant_associations.carrot__lettuce: Complementary use of the soil: deep root and surface leaves.
plant_associations.carrot__radish: Fast radishes mark the rows and loosen the soil for carrots.
plant_associations.carrot__pea: Peas enrich the soil with nitrogen.
plant_associations.lettuce__radish: Fast crops that share the space well.
plant_associations.lettuce__strawberry: Lettuce covers the soil between strawberry plants.
plant_associations.cucumber__lettuce: Cucumber foliage shades the lettuce in summer.
plant_associations.beetroot__lettuce: Different root depths, good use of the soil.
plant_associations.corn__green_bean: Corn supports the bean, the bean brings nitrogen ("three sisters" planting).
plant_associations.green_bean__squash: Squash covers the soil, the bean enriches it with nitrogen ("three sisters").
plant_associations.corn__squash: Squash keeps the soil cool at the foot of the corn ("three sisters").
plant_associations.green_bean__potato: Beans are said to repel the Colorado potato beetle.
plant_associations.eggplant__green_bean: Beans are said to repel the Colorado potato beetle from eggplants.
plant_associations.green_bean__zucchini: Beans enrich the soil with nitrogen for the hungry zucchini.
plant_associations.cucumber__dill: Dill attracts beneficial insects that help cucumbers.
plant_associations.nasturtium__zucchini: Nasturtium draws aphids away from zucchini.
plant_associations.cabbage__celery: Celery repels the cabbage white butterfly.
plant_associations.cabbage__thyme: Thyme repels the cabbage white butterfly.
plant_associations.garlic__strawberry: Garlic is said to limit fungal diseases of strawberries.
plant_associations.leek__strawberry: Leek is said to limit strawberry diseases.
plant_associations.spinach__strawberry: Spinach covers the soil between strawberry plants.
plant_associations.celery__leek: Celery and leek protect each other from their pests.
plant_associations.basil__pepper: Basil repels some pests of bell peppers.
plant_associations.potato__tomato: Same family (nightshades): they share blight and the same pests.
plant_associations.fennel__tomato: Fennel slows down the growth of tomatoes.
plant_associations.cabbage__tomato: Competition and slower growth for both.
plant_associations.green_bean__onion: Alliums slow down the growth of beans.
plant_associations.garlic__green_bean: Alliums slow down the growth of beans.
plant_associations.green_bean__leek: Alliums slow down the growth of beans.
plant_associations.fennel__green_bean: Fennel slows down the growth of beans.
plant_associations.onion__pea: Alliums slow down the growth of peas.
plant_associations.garlic__pea: Alliums slow down the growth of peas.
plant_associations.potato__squash: Competition for water and nutrients, both susceptible to blight.
plant_associations.cucumber__potato: Cucumber is said to encourage potato blight.
plant_associations.cabbage__strawberry: Cabbage hinders the development of strawberries.
plant_associations.carrot__dill: Same family (umbellifers): flowering dill can slow down carrots.
